public_contract: Reduction is documented as Noise attenuation amount,0–40dB. Zero requested attenuation must produce a unity transfer at the unchanged public FFT latency, including optional modes and captured profiles.
implementation_plan: Keep all estimation/analysis warm. A fixed scalar unity mix after optional gain combination snaps to its target on fresh/reset streams and uses prepared attack/release coefficients for live zero/nonzero transitions. The ordinary positive-reduction path remains bit-identical.
acceptance: Independent complete-stream delayed-input oracle at2e-6 across4rates,2FFTs,1/2/6channels and optional modes.
Captured profiles do not override zero attenuation.
Exact reset/irregular partitions and existing finite-stream/heap gates.
All36 preexisting positive-default recorded estimator rows remain exact.
limits: This fixes a public zero-depth endpoint; it does not claim that default positive-reduction startup or low-SNR vowel preservation is resolved.
